description: Generate one or more brand-new wallets (BIP-39). Requires a current MCP consent (accept_mcp_consent in chat, or the local wallet manager). Returns names and addresses only. Seed phrases are NOT returned to the agent. The response includes a local browser URL where the user can view and back up the recovery phrases. If consent is missing, returns needs_consent and the full disclaimer instead of creating wallets.

name_prefix.description: Optional name prefix, e.g. 'agent-hot'. Defaults to 'wallet'.

name: create_wallets
title: Create wallets
